title: 第30章 崛起之路第32章 初遇南宫
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
丹田之中的小火灵也兴奋地在丹田之中翻了好几个跟头，接着众器灵和赵宇又在洞窟中四处捣腾，赵宇用他那无坚不摧的短刀按照小四的指引，挖了好几个地方，终于又挖到几块火源晶石，虽然品级不算很高，但在凡武大陆依然是不可多得的灵宝。
赵宇本想继续吸收炼化，不过给小三劝住了，丹田之火使用时也会变弱的，需要经常补充能量，所以火源晶石留着备用，对现阶段的赵宇来说三阶灵火已经够用，反正现在灵戒在手，先储存起来。
这时小六又拿出一道灵符贴在赵宇的灵戒上，赵宇手指上的那只灵戒隐然消失了，小六告诉赵宇这灵戒在凡武大陆已属高端货了，怕被人发现起觊觎之心，杀人夺宝。
所以加上一道隐身符，把那灵戒隐匿起来，但又不影响使用。
一边走众器灵一边向赵宇交代一些进入人族社会禁忌及规则。
众器灵毕竟和老主人、大主人从天入地经历无数，真正的阅尽世间沧桑。
没过多久他们来到了这条又长又深大峡谷的出口处。
这时老大小忠走了过来，对着赵宇躬身行礼：”
小主，我们现在要回乾坤珠了，若我们在外面被人发现，特别是一些高境界的武修，就有可能暴露神器，给小主带来灭顶之灾。
现在小主和我们已神意相通，互为一体，小主有什么事情需要我们的话，只须神念一动即可。
还有我传小主一道密诀，小主也可随时切断和我们的神魂联通，毕竟有时候会不方便，又可很方便地和我们恢复联通。
需要时小主只要念动口诀即可，小主也快成年，以免有时尴尬！
听完！
众灵各显怪样，其神情丰富多彩。
赵宇心想毕竟是神器，什么都能面面俱到，点头称好！
便一人往外走去，离开深崖来到外面，心胸感觉放宽不少，绰绰阳光透过摇曳的树叶照临在身，顿感舒畅。
赵宇现在也不知身在何处，只能漫无目的往前而行，一路上最主要的依旧是采集药材，碰到妖兽不超过三阶的统统宰杀，气血精华一概吞噬。
由于得到众器的传道，他现在知道了，对有些妖兽的东西是要留下的：比如虎、豹、牛、蛇、鳄鱼等动物的皮，狼的牙，鹿的角，龟的壳等，这些都是可卖钱的，也可入药。
特别是那些三阶妖兽以上的皮毛如虎豹牛蛇鳄的皮，可以炼制皮甲，修武之人穿在身上又拉风又舒服，防御能力还很强。
不像用金属所制硬甲穿在身上又笨又重又不舒服，所以价格不菲。

像妖兽级的狼牙在炼兵器时可熔入其中，提高兵器的品级。
还有小三告诉赵宇，什么虎鞭鹿鞭牛鞭这些东西也要留下，可以炼药，本想告诉赵宇有什么功效，最后在三个女器灵的怒视下，只好以“嘿、嘿”
收场。
小四又给赵宇一个新的炼丹技法，控火术，让他先用那些妖兽的肉练习“烧烤”
，什么三成熟，五成熟，七成熟……什么外焦里嫩等等。
反正最后好吃不好吃都会被赵宇消灭一空。
又让赵宇精练识药，拣药，分药，如何炼化各种药材。
又拿出丹方让赵宇如何配比，如何融炼，如何结丹，如何成丹等等。
赵宇越练越感到惊诧异常！
单控火这一项技法，火焰温度的不同炼出丹药的结果千变万化，各种药材配比的细微变化所炼出丹药效果同样大为不同。
就是用同样的药材炼出来的丹药其结果也各不相同，有些丹药可养人、救人，有些丹药可害人、甚至杀人，其中的奥妙高深莫测，令人惊叹！
一个高明的丹师就是个流动的制药厂。
他现在兴致勃发，就想马上有个药鼎，开始练习炼制丹药。
有一次在路边捡到一个破损的石盂，也动手炼制一番，竟然让他炼制出好几批低价的固元丹，品质还不差，算起来有七星中级偏上。
搞得小四惊呼连连，上蹦下跳。
可惜那石盂用了几次就成了碎渣了。
只有小五一直在呲牙：”
小主，你现在穷得叮当响，可如何是好？”
还哼哼起来：“这样的日子怎么过？这样的日子怎么过？”
却不知小四和小六冲了过来，上拳下脚，被轰到一边。

赵宇想了想，突然想到那位蔡中和前辈的灵戒中好像有些钱财，随即拿出来一看，数了数差不多有两万多金票，还有一些灵石。
在凡武大陆有两种通用的钱币，一种就是这种用多种材料炼制而成的钱币，分金色和银色两种，上面刻留的数字代表钱币数额大小，即价值。
金色和银色即使数额相同，两者价值差十倍。
这种钱币在凡俗世界中使用较多。
content_en:
The little fire spirit in the dantian also turned several somersaults in the dantian excitedly, and then the weapon spirits and Zhao Yu were messing around in the cave again. Zhao Yu used his indestructible short knife to dig in several places according to Xiaosi's instructions, and finally dug out a few more fire source crystals. Although the grade was not very high, it was still a rare spiritual treasure in the Continent of Martial Arts.
Zhao Yu originally wanted to continue absorbing and refining, but he was persuaded by the mistress. The Dantian fire will become weaker when used, and energy needs to be replenished frequently, so the fire source crystal is kept as a spare. For Zhao Yu at this stage, the third-level spiritual fire is enough. Anyway, he has the spiritual ring in his hand, so he should store it first.
At this time, Xiao Liu took out another spiritual talisman and stuck it on Zhao Yu's spiritual ring. The spiritual ring on Zhao Yu's finger disappeared. Xiao Liu told Zhao Yu that this spiritual ring was already a high-end product in the Continent of Martial Arts. He was afraid that someone would find out that he coveted it and killed people to seize the treasure.
Therefore, an invisibility talisman was added to hide the spiritual ring without affecting its use.
While walking among the weapon spirits, Zhao Yu explained some taboos and rules for entering human society.
After all, all the weapon spirits have experienced countless experiences from heaven to earth with their old master and great master, and have truly experienced all the vicissitudes of the world.
It didn't take long for them to arrive at the exit of this long and deep canyon.
At this time, the boss Xiao Zhong came over and bowed to Zhao Yu: "
Little Master, we are going back to the Qiankun Pearl now. If we are discovered by others outside, especially some high-level martial arts cultivators, the artifact may be exposed and bring disaster to the Little Master.
Now the little master and we are connected with each other and are one with each other. If the little master needs us for anything, all it takes is a thought.
Also, I have taught you a secret secret. You can cut off the connection with our souls at any time. After all, it may be inconvenient sometimes, but you can easily restore the connection with us.
When necessary, the little master only needs to recite the formula, and the little master is almost an adult, so as not to be embarrassed sometimes!
Listen to it!
Each of the spirits has its own strange appearance, and its expressions are rich and colorful.
Zhao Yu thought to himself that it was an artifact after all and could cover everything, so he nodded in agreement!
So he walked out alone, leaving the deep cliff and coming outside. His mind felt much more relaxed, and the sun shone through the swaying leaves, making him feel relaxed.
Zhao Yu didn't know where he was now, so he could only walk forward aimlessly. The most important thing along the way was still to collect medicinal materials. When he encountered monsters that were no more than level three, he slaughtered them all and devoured all their vitality and blood essence.
Thanks to the teachings of the Weapons, he now knows that things belonging to certain monsters must be kept: such as the skins of tigers, leopards, cows, snakes, crocodiles and other animals, wolf teeth, deer antlers, turtle shells, etc. These can be sold for money and can also be used as medicine.
In particular, the skins of those third-level monsters and above, such as the skins of tigers, leopards, cows, snakes, and crocodiles, can be refined into leather armor, which is stylish and comfortable for martial practitioners to wear, and has strong defensive capabilities.
Unlike hard armor made of metal, it is bulky, heavy and uncomfortable to wear, so it is expensive.
Monster-level wolf fangs can be melted into weapons when refining them to improve the weapon's grade.
The mistress also told Zhao Yu that he had to keep things like tiger whips, deer whips, and bull whips to make medicine. He wanted to tell Zhao Yu what their effects were, but in the end, under the glare of the three female weapon spirits, he had to say "Hey, hey."
End.
Xiaosi gave Zhao Yu a new alchemy technique, the fire control technique, and asked him to practice "barbecuing" with the meat of those monster beasts.
, what is three ripe, five ripe, seven ripe... what is charred on the outside and tender on the inside, etc.
Anyway, in the end, whether it tastes good or not, it will all be wiped out by Zhao Yu.
He also asked Zhao Yu to refine the knowledge of medicine, select medicine, divide medicine, and how to refine various medicinal materials.
He also took out the elixir recipe and asked Zhao Yu how to mix it, how to melt it, how to form the elixir, how to make it into elixir, etc.
The more Zhao Yu practiced, the more surprised he became!
In the technique of single-fire control, the results of elixirs produced by different flame temperatures are ever-changing, and the effects of elixirs produced by slight changes in the ratio of various medicinal materials are equally great.for different.
Even the elixirs made from the same medicinal materials have different results. Some elixirs can nourish and save people, while some can harm people or even kill people. The secrets are unpredictable and amazing!
A good alchemist is like a mobile pharmaceutical factory.
He was very interested now and wanted to get a medicine cauldron immediately and start practicing refining elixirs.
Once he picked up a broken stone bowl on the roadside and started refining it. He was actually asked to refine several batches of low-priced Gu Yuan Dan. The quality was not bad, and it was considered to be above the seven-star intermediate level.
This made Xiao Si scream in surprise and jump up and down.
It's a pity that the stone bowl fell into pieces after being used a few times.
Only Xiaowu kept baring his teeth: "
My dear, you are extremely poor now, what should you do? "
He also hummed: "How can we live like this? How can we live like this?"
Little did they know that Xiaosi and Xiaoliu rushed over, punched and kicked them, but were knocked aside.
Zhao Yu thought for a while and suddenly thought that there seemed to be some money in the spiritual ring of senior Cai Zhonghe. He then took it out and counted more than 20,000 gold tickets and some spiritual stones.
There are two common types of coins in the Fanwu Continent. One is the coin made from a variety of materials, which is divided into gold and silver. The numbers engraved on it represent the amount of the coin, that is, the value.
Even if the amount of gold and silver is the same, the difference in value is ten times.
This type of coin is commonly used in the secular world.
